title: i18n: the label ResolveOptions (request locale, fallback chain, sourceLocale else defaultLocale) is assembled in four copies that can drift (follow-up to #34030)
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZiaBg6rk7dpy1s9Me

Filing gate: ② should-fix S2 of the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` record on PR #35351 (comment 7003535421), routed by seat 5 as a follow-up under #34030. ⛔ Not a claim; triage sets lane and grade (the seat suggests p3).

## What drifts

Once PR #35351 lands, the `ResolveOptions` that `translateObject` is handed for a label read are assembled in four places:

- `metaTranslateOptions` (`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`, the `/meta` route)
- `readerOptionLabels` (`packages/objectql/src/formula-option-labels.ts`)
- `labelTranslationOf` (objectql validation message context, added by #35351)
- `denialLabels` (plugin-security authz middleware, added by #35351)

The language rule itself lives in one place (`translateObject`). How its options are put together (request locale, the declared `fallbackChain`, then `sourceLocale` else `defaultLocale`) is repeated, so a later change to one copy can leave refusals and `/meta` speaking different languages again — the defect #34030 fixed. #35351's claim allowed no new shared helper, so it is a follow-up.

## Fix direction

One exported builder that the four call, with a pin that every label reader gets the same options as `/meta` for the same request.

Dedupe: issue search `ResolveOptions builder copies`, `metaTranslateOptions labelTranslationOf denialLabels` → none.
